description: List the space's backups, newest first: each is a Cube's disk and configuration kept after the Cube is gone, redeployable as a new Cube. `sharedFromBackupId` is set on a copy another space shared with this one. Needs the View Backups permission.

spaceId.description: Krova Cloud Space id. Optional if KROVA_SPACE_ID is set as the server default.

name: list_backups
title: List Backups
